caption: Pair counts and group counts in the evaluated subset. Phantom groups remain provisional without acquisition metadata.
Training crops are random; validation crops are fixed. Their objectives are not identical sampling distributions.
Held-out mechanics evidence. These indicators are proxies when reference displacement is unavailable.
Scatterplots describe empirical relationships; correlation alone cannot establish conditional independence.
Feature correlations, with constant-feature entries displayed as zero. Graphical-model independence assumptions are evaluated separately.
Proxy comparisons on the same center crops. Lower reconstruction loss does not by itself establish more accurate displacement.
Ranking measures quality-rule imitation using the same evidence that defines the rule. They are not independent accuracy metrics.
Platt calibration is fitted on calibration groups only. One-class or tiny calibration sets retain raw BN probabilities.
Coverage is descriptive for the evaluated subset. Phantom file groups do not guarantee acquisition independence.
Actions refer to research mechanics handling. Costs and the probability threshold are illustrative.
Chance node = operational failure; decision = action; utility = negative cost. All costs are assumptions, not clinical recommendations.

F = proxy failure, Z = latent evidence pattern, Xi = binarized quality feature. Co-parents F and Z are already joined in this DAG; a separate collider example in pgm_results.json demonstrates a newly added marriage edge.
Bernoulli-mixture components describe quality patterns and have no intrinsic ordering or tumor-grade interpretation.
EM fits an unlabeled Bernoulli mixture; smoothed soft counts then fit the supervised proxy-event BN. This is a two-stage estimator.
Standardization, PCA and clustering are fitted on training embeddings. Cluster IDs are descriptive and are not histological grades.
Strain is a deformation measurement under unknown loading. It does not supply absolute stiffness or tumor grade.
HMM filtering uses past evidence; smoothing uses the complete sequence. This educational example does not infer time from unrelated phantom filenames.
HMM parameters are explicit educational assumptions, not fitted temporal measurements from the RF archive.
The moral graph encodes separation statements. Multiplying the original family CPDs preserves the BN joint; moralization alone does not define new probabilities.
Groups are resampled, not individual pixels. Intervals reflect only the evaluated subset and chosen manifest grouping; mixed endpoints retain their native units.
Dropout spread is a sensitivity measure, not a calibrated probability of displacement error.
Fixed display limits facilitate comparison; raw numeric maps retain unclipped values. This is mechanics analysis without pathology grades.
Unit 3: feature-conditioned spatial MRF. ICM finds a local minimum; labels indicate spatial quality patterns, not tumors.

Xi uses its frozen training median. Every other feature is marginalized, so these are exact single-evidence BN queries, not causal effects or feature importance.
An omitted observation is marginalized rather than replaced by zero. Curves use actual held-out cases with lowest/highest raw BN scores; the fixed evidence order is not an importance ranking.

Positive differences favor neural reconstruction. Group bootstrap preserves pairing. Supports can differ after warping; these are reconstruction proxies, not reference displacement errors. Exploratory sign tests in JSON are unadjusted and rely on group independence.
ECDFs use every selected held-out pair, then one mean per manifest group. A curve farther left has lower reconstruction loss; accuracy cannot be inferred without reference motion.
Held-out distribution summaries expose spread and outliers. Boxplots are descriptive; source domains can differ in noise, motion, loading, and pairing assumptions.

This sensitivity plot changes the definition of the operational event; it does not measure model discrimination or tune a clinical cutoff. Cyan lines mark the current declared thresholds. Folding/support limits stay fixed.
Flags use the same features that define the proxy target. Causes can overlap and indicate rule violations, not independently verified physical failure mechanisms.
These curves describe cutoff trade-offs on held-out proxy outcomes. Blank segments mean no accepted pairs or no event denominator. This is a research handling rule, not patient triage.
The adjustment was fitted only on calibration groups. Identity movement is expected when calibration was skipped; the calibrator status remains in summary.json.
Entropy is computed from the train-fitted Bernoulli mixture. A low-entropy evidence pattern may still be confidently unreliable; entropy alone is not an error probability.
Clusters were fitted only on training embeddings. A domain-dominated cluster is evidence of acquisition structure, not a tissue diagnosis. Cluster indices have no ordinal meaning.

Groups are ordered by predicted proxy risk, with at most twelve displayed. Heatmap colors are within-test feature ranks; native-unit means for every group are exported in JSON. Phantom grouping remains provisional without acquisition IDs.

Profiles summarize valid lateral samples at each depth. Shading is spatial interquartile spread, not an uncertainty interval or pathology-linked tissue estimate. Border depths with no support are left blank.
Arrow magnification is explicitly reported and changes only display length. RF waveforms preserve carrier phase; a central line is an inspection aid rather than a complete 2D registration metric.

Jacobian colors show a symmetric range around one, clipped at the 99th percentile of deviation. Red pixels mark Jacobian <= 0 inside valid support. Shared histogram bins show the central 99% strain range across saved examples; tail counts and raw maps remain available.

Measured reconstruction and cycle sensitivity. Gain mismatch is applied after shared normalization; local correlation can be gain invariant. Lines are pair means; shading is the observed pair range, not a confidence interval.
Frozen BN proxy risk and mean flow change from clean input. Flow change is sensitivity, not displacement error. Lines are pair means; shading is the observed pair range, not a confidence interval.
CUDA timings synchronize the device. Latencies include two network directions, exclude quality-map computation, and are not a hardware benchmark; event parameters have different units.
Independent known translations of a continuous synthetic texture. All estimators use the same truth-defined interior. These are fixture results, not real RF accuracy or clinical evidence.
Rigid translations have exactly zero strain; nonzero estimated strain is an artifact in this reference fixture. ECDF weights each controlled case equally.
